title: Groundwater / baseflow store
simLoop: Soil moisture above field capacity recharges a per-cell GW store; linear-reservoir baseflow returns water preferentially on high-accumulation cells so channels persist between storms.
gameLoop: A dry spell does not instantly empty the hollow — storage seeps, not a silent leak (legibility of persistence deferred to a later Tier-O batch).
notebookSeed: The hollow kept seeping after the rain stopped.
tierO: no owner-only question; deferred until persistence is visible without inspector
